Inherited nucleoside metabolic abnormality; urinary uridine and cytidine elevation does not establish renal damage.

Leydig-cell androgen deficiency; hypospadias is a structural urethral defect reported in 80-99%. Delayed skeletal maturation is secondary to hormone deficiency.

Paget neoplasia of perianal skin or anal canal epithelium; associated internal colorectal malignancy is a separate cancer.
BBS17 spectrum: retinal dystrophy and obesity/hypogonadism; renal disease ~50% and cognitive impairment >30% in BBS. Skeletal anomalies omitted by cap; subtype rates uncertain.
Defined by progressive hemiparkinsonism and unilateral body tissue atrophy; scoliosis is a minority finding.
Anterior chamber angle closure causes elevated intraocular pressure and optic nerve damage.
